doc_description: Amcor plc’s July 1, 2022 Form 8-K reporting that, via June 30, 2022 supplemental indentures, Amcor Flexibles North America, Inc. was substituted for Amcor Finance (USA), Inc. as issuer of the 3.625% notes due 2026 and 4.500% notes due 2028 under the 2016 and 2019 indentures, with Deutsche Bank Trust Company Americas as trustee (filed as Exhibits 4.6 and 4.7).

structure.title: Other Events.
structure.heading: Item 8.01 Other Events.
structure.start_phrase: On June 30, 2022, Amcor Finance (USA), Inc. (the “Former Issuer”) and Amcor Flexibles North America, Inc. (the “Substitute Issuer”), each a wholly-owned subsidiary of Amcor plc (the “Company”),
structure.summary: The filing reports that on June 30, 2022, Amcor Flexibles North America, Inc. (a wholly owned subsidiary of Amcor plc) was substituted as issuer in place of Amcor Finance (USA), Inc. for certain Amcor guaranteed senior notes via two supplemental indentures: a Second Supplemental Indenture to the April 28, 2016 Indenture covering the 3.625% Notes due 2026 and 4.500% Notes due 2028 (the “Existing Notes”), and a First Supplemental Indenture to the June 13, 2019 Indenture covering the corresponding “New” 2026 and 2028 Notes issued in 2019 after an exchange offer. Under these actions, the substitute issuer assumed the former issuer’s covenants under both indentures. Deutsche Bank Trust Company Americas remains trustee. The document also lists and incorporates by reference the underlying indentures, forms of the notes, and the June 30, 2022 supplemental indentures as exhibits, along with the cover page XBRL data.

structure.title: Financial Statements and Exhibits.
structure.heading: Item 9.01 Financial Statements and Exhibits.
structure.start_phrase: 4.1 Indenture, dated as of April 28, 2016, among Amcor Finance (USA), Inc., Amcor Limited, Amcor UK Finance PLC and Deutsche Bank Trust Company Americas (incorporated by reference to Exhibit 4.7 to Amcor plc’s Registration Statement on Form S-4 (File No. 333-230217), filed on March 12, 2019).
structure.summary:
- The company reports that on June 30, 2022, Amcor Flexibles North America, Inc. (Substitute Issuer) was substituted for Amcor Finance (USA), Inc. (Former Issuer) as issuer under both the 2016 and 2019 Indentures, with the Substitute Issuer assuming the Former Issuer’s covenants.
- This was effected through a Second Supplemental Indenture to the 2016 Indenture and a First Supplemental Indenture to the 2019 Indenture, each with Deutsche Bank Trust Company Americas as trustee.
- The affected securities include the 3.625% Guaranteed Senior Notes due 2026 and 4.500% Guaranteed Senior Notes due 2028 under the 2016 Indenture (Existing Notes), and the corresponding New 2026 and New 2028 Notes issued in June 2019 under the 2019 Indenture following an exchange offer.
- The filing references prior SEC filings containing the base indentures and forms of notes and includes the June 30, 2022 supplemental indentures as Exhibits 4.6 and 4.7.
- Item 9.01 lists exhibits covering: the 2016 Indenture, the June 13, 2019 supplemental indenture, forms of the 2026 and 2028 notes, the June 13, 2019 Indenture, the June 30, 2022 Second and First Supplemental Indentures, and the cover page XBRL data.

structure.summary:
- Exhibit 4.6 is a Second Supplemental Indenture dated June 30, 2022 among Amcor Finance (USA), Inc. (Former Issuer), Amcor Flexibles North America, Inc. (Substitute Issuer), and Deutsche Bank Trust Company Americas (Trustee).
- It relates to an existing Indenture dated April 28, 2016, with Amcor Pty Ltd as Parent Guarantor and Amcor UK Finance plc as Initial Subsidiary Guarantor, covering the Former Issuer’s 3.625% Guaranteed Senior Notes due 2026 and 4.500% Guaranteed Senior Notes due 2028.
- Citing Section 901 of the Indenture, the document confirms that, without holder consent, a supplemental indenture may evidence substitution of a new issuer and the assumption of the former issuer’s covenants.
- The Supplemental Indenture effects the substitution: Amcor Flexibles North America, Inc. becomes the Issuer under the Indenture and assumes all covenants and obligations, including responsibility for all amounts due on outstanding securities.
- The parties state that all necessary authorizations and actions have been taken, making this a valid amendment and supplement to the Indenture.
- Capitalized terms not defined in the supplement carry the meanings from the original Indenture.

nodes.title: Submission to Jurisdiction; Appointment of Agent for Service of Process.
nodes.heading: Section 102. Submission to Jurisdiction; Appointment of Agent for Service of Process.
nodes.start_phrase: The Substitute Issuer hereby appoints C T Corporation acting through its office at 28 Liberty Street, New York, New York, 10005, as its authorized agent (the “Authorized Agent”)
nodes.summary:
- Appointment of Authorized Agent: The Substitute Issuer appoints C T Corporation, 28 Liberty Street, New York, NY 10005, as its agent for service of process for actions relating to obligations under the Indenture in federal or state courts in the Borough of Manhattan.
- Jurisdiction and venue: The Substitute Issuer irrevocably submits to the non-exclusive jurisdiction of those New York courts and waives objections to venue.
- Effectiveness of service: Service on the Authorized Agent, with written notice to the Substitute Issuer (and, where specified, to the Former Issuer and Guarantors), constitutes effective service on the Substitute Issuer; the Agent’s address may be updated within Manhattan by notice.
- Duration and succession of agency: The appointment is irrevocable until all principal, premium, and interest under the Securities are paid and the Indenture is satisfied/discharged. The Substitute Issuer may appoint a successor Authorized Agent in Manhattan and must notify the Trustee and Holders; it must maintain an Authorized Agent in Manhattan, appointing a successor if C T Corporation cannot serve or lacks a Manhattan address.
- Trustee disclaimer: The Trustee is not responsible for the validity or sufficiency of the Supplemental Indenture or for the recitals, which are made solely by the Former Issuer and the Substitute Issuer.
- Effective Date: The Supplemental Indenture becomes effective when each party executes a counterpart; upon effectiveness, the Substitute Issuer is deemed the Issuer under the Indenture.
- Governing law: The Supplemental Indenture is governed by New York law (including GOL §5-1401), excluding New York choice-of-law principles that would apply another jurisdiction’s law; the Substitute Issuer’s authorization and execution are governed by Missouri law.
- Counterparts: The instrument may be executed in multiple counterparts, all constituting one agreement.
- Headings: Article and Section headings are for convenience only and do not affect interpretation.

- The Trustee is not responsible for the validity or sufficiency of the Supplemental Indenture or its recitals; recitals are solely those of the Former Issuer and Substitute Issuer.
- Effective Date occurs upon execution of counterparts by each party; from that date the Substitute Issuer is deemed the Issuer under the Indenture.
- Governing law is New York law (including GOL §5-1401), excluding conflicting choice-of-law rules; the Substitute Issuer’s authorization and execution are governed by Missouri law; the instrument may be executed in counterparts.
- Headings are for convenience only and do not affect interpretation.

nodes.title: ARTICLE TWO
nodes.heading: ARTICLE TWO
nodes.start_phrase: This Supplemental Indenture takes effect when each party has executed one counterpart of this deed, whether the same or different counterparts (the “Effective Date”).
nodes.summary:
- Section 102: Establishes submission to jurisdiction and service-of-process mechanics. The Substitute Issuer appoints C T Corporation (28 Liberty Street, New York, NY 10005) as Authorized Agent for service of process in any federal or state court in Manhattan regarding obligations under the Indenture. Service on the Authorized Agent, with written notice to the Substitute Issuer, constitutes effective service. The Substitute Issuer irrevocably submits to the non-exclusive jurisdiction of such courts and waives venue objections. The appointment is irrevocable until all Securities (principal, premium, interest) and Guarantees are fully satisfied and discharged under the Indenture (Articles Four/Twelve). The Substitute Issuer may appoint a successor Authorized Agent in Manhattan, must notify the Trustee and all Holders of any such appointment, and must maintain an effective agent until the Indenture is satisfied. If C T Corporation cannot act or lacks a Manhattan address, a successor must be appointed. Service at the Authorized Agent’s address, with written notice to the Former Issuer, Substitute Issuer, and Guarantors, is deemed effective.

- Section 103: The Trustee disclaims responsibility for the validity or sufficiency of the Supplemental Indenture and its recitals, which are solely those of the Former Issuer and Substitute Issuer.

- Article Two – Provisions of General Application:
  - Section 201 (Effective Date): The Supplemental Indenture is effective when each party executes a counterpart; as of that date, the Substitute Issuer is deemed the Issuer under the Indenture.
  - Section 202 (Governing Law): Governed by New York law (including GOL §5-1401), excluding its conflict-of-law principles; authorization and execution by/on behalf of the Substitute Issuer are governed by Missouri law. The instrument may be executed in counterparts, all constituting one document.
  - Section 203 (Effect of Headings): Headings are for convenience only and do not affect construction.

nodes.title: Substitution of the Issuer under the Indenture.
nodes.heading: Section 101. Substitution of the Issuer under the Indenture.
nodes.start_phrase: For good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which is hereby acknowledged, the Substitute Issuer hereby agrees with the Former Issuer, the Guarantors,
nodes.summary:
- Document: First Supplemental Indenture dated June 30, 2022 (Exhibit 4.7).
- Parties: Amcor Finance (USA), Inc. (Former Issuer), Amcor Flexibles North America, Inc. (formerly Bemis Company, Inc.; Substitute Issuer), and Deutsche Bank Trust Company Americas (Trustee).
- Background: Supplements the Indenture dated June 13, 2019 among the Former Issuer, Amcor plc (Parent Guarantor), Amcor Pty Ltd, Amcor Flexibles North America, Inc., Amcor UK Finance plc, and the Trustee.
- Securities referenced: 3.625% Guaranteed Senior Notes due 2026 and 4.500% Guaranteed Senior Notes due 2028.
- Legal basis: Section 901 of the Indenture permits issuer succession/substitution without holder consent.
- Main action: Substitution of Amcor Flexibles North America, Inc. as the Issuer under the Indenture for all outstanding Securities.
- Assumption: The Substitute Issuer assumes all covenants and obligations of the Former Issuer under the Indenture and the Securities, including all amounts due and owing.
- Authorization/validity: The supplemental indenture is authorized and constitutes a valid amendment and supplement to the Indenture.

nodes.title: Submission to Jurisdiction; Appointment of Agent for Service of Process.
nodes.heading: Section 102. Submission to Jurisdiction; Appointment of Agent for Service of Process.
nodes.start_phrase: The Substitute Issuer hereby appoints C T Corporation acting through its office at 28 Liberty Street, New York, New York, 10005, as its authorized agent (the “Authorized Agent”)
nodes.summary:
- Submission to jurisdiction and agent for service of process: The Substitute Issuer appoints C T Corporation (28 Liberty Street, New York, NY 10005) as Authorized Agent for service of process in legal actions regarding obligations under the Indenture in federal or state courts in Manhattan, New York. Service on the Authorized Agent, with written notice to the Substitute Issuer, is deemed effective service on the Substitute Issuer. The Substitute Issuer irrevocably submits to the non-exclusive jurisdiction of such courts and waives venue objections.
- Duration and replacement of agent: The appointment is irrevocable until all principal, premium, and interest on Securities under the Indenture are fully paid. The Substitute Issuer may appoint a successor Authorized Agent in Manhattan; upon acceptance, the prior appointment terminates. The Substitute Issuer must notify the Trustee and all Holders of any successor appointment and take all steps necessary to keep the designation effective until the Indenture is satisfied and discharged. If C T Corporation cannot act or lacks a Manhattan address, a successor must be appointed. Service on the Authorized Agent, with notice to the Former Issuer, Substitute Issuer, and Guarantors, remains effective.
- Trustee disclaimer: The Trustee is not responsible for the validity or sufficiency of the Supplemental Indenture or the accuracy of its recitals, which are solely those of the Former Issuer and Substitute Issuer.
- Effective date: The Supplemental Indenture becomes effective when each party executes a counterpart, and at that time the Substitute Issuer is deemed the Issuer under the Indenture.
- Governing law and execution: Governed by New York law (including GOL §5-1401), excluding conflicting choice-of-law principles; the Substitute Issuer’s authorization and execution are governed by Missouri law. The instrument may be executed in counterparts, each deemed an original, collectively forming one instrument.
